user.title: Connect your Smart Garden
user.description: Usually Home Assistant finds your garden by itself (Settings → Devices & services → Discovered). To add it by hand, type its address and leave the key empty: Home Assistant shows a code and an admin taps **Allow** in Smart Garden.

data_description.url: The address you open Smart Garden at, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:5120
data_description.key: Leave empty to pair with a code. Or paste a key made in Smart Garden (My account → Connection keys) - it starts with sg_.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Smart Garden
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant's key for {url} was revoked or its account is off. Leave the key empty and press **Submit** to pair again with a code, or paste a new connection key.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Smart Garden found
zeroconf_confirm.description:
Found **{name}** at {url}.

Press **Submit** and Home Assistant will show a code; an admin then taps **Allow** in Smart Garden. (Or paste a connection key instead.)

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach Smart Garden at that address, or it needs updating to a version with connection keys.
error.invalid_auth: That connection key is wrong or revoked (after 5 wrong tries, wait 15 minutes).
error.pair_unsupported: That Smart Garden can't pair yet - update the app, or paste a connection key.
error.pair_busy: Smart Garden has too many pairing requests waiting - try again in a few minutes.

abort.already_configured: This garden is already set up.
abort.wrong_garden: That address is a different garden.
abort.pair_denied: Smart Garden turned the request down.
abort.pair_expired: Nobody tapped Allow in time. Start again from Settings → Devices & services.
abort.not_a_garden: That device isn't a Smart Garden.
abort.cannot_connect: Paired, but Smart Garden can't be reached now - try again.

data.sidebar: Show the Smart Garden dashboard in the sidebar
data.panel_url: Also show the full app at this address (optional)

data_description.panel_url: Adds a second sidebar item with the whole Smart Garden app. It only stays signed in when the address is on the same site as Home Assistant - for HTTPS, e.g. https://your-ha-address/garden/ through your reverse proxy. Leave empty for just the dashboard.

water.name: Water zone
water.description: Water a zone for some minutes, or until its soil sensor says it's right. Waits its turn if another zone is watering; the zone's safety limit always applies.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long. Leave empty for the zone's usual minutes.

until_soil.name: Until the soil is right
until_soil.description: Stop when the soil sensor reaches the zone's target (needs a working soil sensor).
